testCases.title: Audit trail records operator entry on GxP-critical change
testCases.objective: Proposed positive test to verify audit trail captures operator identity and timestamp when a GxP-critical result is modified.
preconditions: Test analyst account exists with appropriate role
Audit trail enabled for target record type
Test environment available per validation plan

steps.action: Given an approved GxP-critical sample result, when the analyst modifies the result value, then save the record.
steps.expectedObservation: Audit trail entry records user id, timestamp, prior value, and new value.

steps.action: When a QA reviewer opens the audit trail report for the record, then filter by the modification event.
steps.expectedObservation: Report displays the modification event with readable operator and timestamp fields.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions.

testCases.title: Unauthorized user cannot modify GxP-critical record without audit entry
testCases.objective: Proposed negative test to verify access control prevents unauthorized modification.
preconditions: Unauthorized test account exists without modify privilege

steps.action: Given an unauthorized user session, when the user attempts to modify a GxP-critical record, then submit the change.
steps.expectedObservation: System denies the modification and does not create a successful change audit entry for the unauthorized user.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Limiting system access to authorized individuals.

testCases.title: Audit trail review cadence documented
testCases.objective: Proposed test to confirm periodic audit-trail review workflow is executable per SOP draft.
preconditions: SOP-CSV-AUDIT-REVIEW-004 draft available for test script alignment

steps.action: Given audit-trail entries spanning the review period, when QA performs the documented review procedure, then record the review outcome.
steps.expectedObservation: Review record shows reviewer identity, date, and scope of records reviewed.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Relevant changes to GxP critical data should be recorded and traceable to the person who made the change.
